title: Register lichen-schc link_layer_integration test with required-features
description: cargo test -p lichen-schc with default features fails to compile: tests/link_layer_integration.rs is auto-discovered (no [[test]] entry in rust/lichen-schc/Cargo.toml) and uses std-only APIs (FragmentationPolicy::accept_peer, AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::new, lichen_link::identity) without a crate-level cfg gate. Introduced when commit f8cdaec2b3 touched the file; Cargo.toml has [[test]] entries with required-features = ["std", "raw-fragment-codec"] for the other four integration tests but none for this one. Fix: add [[test]] name = "link_layer_integration" required-features = ["std", "raw-fragment-codec"] (or a #![cfg(feature = "std")] gate). Verified 2026-08-29: 12 compile errors under default features; full suite passes with --features std,test-utils,raw-fragment-codec.
